claims: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships are held March 19-21 at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse in Cleveland, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships feature six sessions over three days.
All times for the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships schedule are Eastern.
Session I of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Thursday, March 19 at 12:00 p.m. ET.
Session I of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Preliminaries & Pigtails.
Session I of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPN2.
Session II of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Thursday, March 19 at 7:00 p.m. ET.
Session II of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Second Round & Consolation.
Session II of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPN.
Session III of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Friday, March 20 at 12:00 p.m. ET.
Session III of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Quarterfinals & Consolation.
Session III of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPNU.
Session IV of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Friday, March 20 at 8:00 p.m. ET.
Session IV of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Semifinals & Consolation.
Session IV of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPN2.
Session V of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Saturday, March 21 at 11:00 a.m. ET.
Session V of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Medal Matches.
Session V of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPNU.
Session VI of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships is scheduled for Saturday, March 21 at 6:30 p.m. ET.
Session VI of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships includes Finals.
Session VI of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships airs on ESPN.
All matches of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships can also be streamed live on ESPN+.
